subject: gov.protect
name: Data Protection and Privacy Commission
what_would_settle_it: A commencement instrument, an appointment notice, a budget line or a first annual report. The Act provides for an independent Commission; nothing held states whether it has been constituted.
disposition: probed 2026-08-09: the regulator exists and is not a new body. The Act designates the Information Commission, established under the Access to Information Act 2021, as the data protection authority, and a Commissioner responsible for data protection is in post; the Ministry of Information validated an institutional and governance framework for the merged Information and Data Protection and Privacy Commission on 6 March 2025, and the Commission ran community sensitisation on the Act from 22 to 31 October 2025 under the regional digital integration programme. One published landscape dataset states the Act has not commenced. None of this is held; acquisition lines raised.

subject: gov.protect
name: Legal basis for issuing identity cards outside the country
what_would_settle_it: An official response, a regulation or a registry statement covering issuance in Mauritania, Congo and Togo, which the opposition alleged was unlawful in August 2025.
disposition: not probed on this run; probe capped at four across the three units
